t.E421.agn: In the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E421.body: When consumed in excess, it may cause gas and diarrhoea in the gut.
t.E421.eff.0.t: May cause gas, bloating and diarrhoea (laxative effect); in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols
t.E421.eff.1.a: Laxative effect from 10–20 g in a single dose; diarrhoea is common at 40 g or more
t.E421.eff.1.t: A laxative effect and diarrhoea have been reported
t.E421.eval: Polyol (sugar alcohol): in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols; it is avoided in a sensitive-gut (FODMAP) diet.
t.E421.prod: It is produced by hydrogenation of glucose/fructose syrup or by fermentation with yeast.
t.E421.regx.0: The warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E421.summary: A polyol (sugar alcohol) that occurs naturally in seaweeds and mushrooms. It is used as a sweetener and anti-dusting agent in sugar-free chewing gum and confectionery.
t.E421.what: It is a sugar alcohol (polyol): it provides sweetness and bulk in sugar-free products and retains moisture.
